title: Kissed Roasted Russian Mushroom Pilaf
description: A hearty, shattering weeknight Russian dish featuring roasted mushrooms and rice vinegar, made easy with pressure cooking, and suitable for a shojin-friendly diet.
instructions: Heat the oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper, and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Add 2 cups of water and 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid and bring to high pressure, then cook for 10 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally, then fluff the pilaf with a fork.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
